title: KANTO >=1000 HIGH-IMPACT UNRESEARCHED PREFLIGHT 4
scope: Preflight only. Live-reranked only the current 34 Kanto >=1,000 ledger records carrying inventory-unresearched. Existing production, ADOPT, HOLD/DEFER/HARD-CASE/JUDGMENT, duplicates, sibling facility-spaces already formally accounted for, and RaiBoC were excluded. No seat transcription, source JSON, ranges, fingerprints, generated catalog/runtime, or production implementation was performed.

policy.reason: This bounded wave decides currentness, issuer-defined configuration scope, capacity semantics, and whether a later implementation has independent error-detection paths. It does not transcribe seats.
policy.currentness: For every formally opened candidate, current first-party operation and closure/renovation/reconstruction/cessation/reopening notices were checked before a seat-chart conclusion. An issuer-announced long hall closure within twelve months is HOLD in principle. Routine short regular closure days are not treated as long closure.
policy.seatPolicy: Capacity is never identifier evidence. No capacity fitting, inferred seat IDs, inferred alternate configurations, geometry completion, configuration mixing, or third-party chart supplementation is allowed.
policy.crossCheckCarryForward: A human Pass 1/Pass 2 match alone is necessary but insufficient. Future production must also reconcile issuer subtotals and use an independent structural checksum where practical; any material mismatch stops production and returns to the chart.

candidatePool.exclusions: No production, prior ADOPT, formal blocked/HOLD/DEFER/HARD-CASE/JUDGMENT, duplicate/same facility-space, or RaiBoC record entered the candidate pool.

method: Ranked dedicated concert/theatre/ticketed-event halls and ongoing public performance use above capacity alone.
Favoured a current issuer-numbered chart, coherent representative configuration, explicit capacity semantics, and independent checksum prospects.
Penalised arenas, stadia, exhibitions, standing-first venues, movable/event-dependent layouts, and announced long closures even where nominal capacity is large.

rankedTop12.reason: Very high-impact concert/convention hall with issuer chart surface, but its imminent issuer-announced hall-specific long refurbishment was unknown until Gate 1 and is a decisive yield penalty.
Dedicated metropolitan public large hall with dense current ticketed programme, a current linked numbered chart, and explicit fixed/movable/wheelchair semantics.
Purpose-built ticketed civic hall with current programme through 2027, complete issuer-linked chart, floor capacity semantics, and explicit standing/accessibility treatment.
Dedicated concert/theatre hall with current ticketed programme, current linked complete chart, a standard numbered subtotal, and separately disclosed pit/movable/accessibility variants.
Civic large-hall prospect; below opened candidates on current chart and checksum evidence visible from repository metadata.
Regional dedicated large hall with plausible fixed seating, but lower metropolitan impact and no preflight opening after stop.
Dedicated 1,188-seat civic hall; lower impact and unexamined current chart prospect.
Public 1,200-seat hall prospect; below current programme/chart evidence of the opened candidates.
Civic 1,300-seat hall prospect; not opened after the ADOPT stop.
Modern major hall, penalised because conference/multipurpose layout makes a representative numbered set less certain.

Active live venue but standing-first/movable-use semantics lower expected lossless numbered-configuration yield.
